title: Port Calamity promo, 60 s
note: Beat grid measured with librosa 0.10/1.0 from the real recording: median 117.45 bpm (0.5108 s a beat), with small tempo drift, so the edited track's beats are listed in music.grid and every cut is on one of them (tools/promo/timeline.mjs). Edit: track 0-32.07 s (quiet intro, the band comes in at 17 s) + 104.23-132.03 s (lift, a breath at ~40 s, the climb, the final hit at 54.75 s = beat 105, ring-out to 60 s), joined on a same-phase beat with a 60 ms crossfade. The end plate starts on the final hit.

music.credit: Music: 'Swing Machine' by Kevin MacLeod (public domain)

low dolly down Tepid Falls' Main St, wreaths and lights up

tracking the Budget Line along the river, side on, world-locked
shots.setup: g.stage(4); const tr = g.game.world.parts.find((p) => p.derail); P.train = { x: 300, y: 5, z: -2150 }; P.each = () => { const i = tr.info(); P.train.x = i.x; P.train.z = i.z; }; let best = 1e9, hb = 8; for (let h = 6; h < 12; h += 0.05) { g.game.sky.ask(h, 'clear', true); g.step(1); const i = tr.info(); const d = Math.abs(i.z + 2120); if (d < best) { best = d; hb = h; } } g.game.sky.ask(hb, 'clear', true); g.step(1); const i = tr.info(); g.teleport(i.x - 40, i.z, 0); P.each();

shots.move: Thruway pursuit at golden hour: heat 5, police cars behind, the helicopter overhead; camera ahead of the car looking back and up
shots.setup: g.stage(4); g.game.sky.ask(17.6, 'clear', true); const id = g.spawnVehicle('sports', -712, -1110, -3.114); g.drive(id); P.car = g.game.player.vehicle; g.setHeat(5); P.each = () => { g.setHeat(5); g.game.player.health = 100; };
shots.preroll: const st = g.game.systems.find((s) => s.tag === 'police'); const H = st && st.heli; const c = P.car; const rig = [[10, -3.4], [17, 3.2], [26, -2.6]]; const cops = rig.map(([d, s]) => { const id = g.spawnVehicle('cruiser', c.x, c.z - 20, c.h); return g.game.vehicles.list.find((v) => v.id === id); }).filter(Boolean); P.each = () => { g.setHeat(5); g.game.player.health = 100; const fx = Math.sin(c.h), fz = Math.cos(c.h), rx = -fz, rz = fx; cops.forEach((v, k) => { const [d, s] = rig[k]; const w = s + Math.sin((P.t || 0) * 1.7 + k * 2) * 0.6; v.x = c.x - fx * d + rx * w; v.z = c.z - fz * d + rz * w; v.y = c.y; v.h = c.h + Math.sin((P.t || 0) * 1.7 + k * 2) * 0.03; v.vx = c.vx; v.vz = c.vz; v.driver = null; }); if (H) { H.present = true; H.x = c.x - fx * 44 + rx * 7; H.z = c.z - fz * 44 + rz * 7; H.y = c.y + 17; H.h = c.h; } }; setTimeout(() => {}, 0); console.log('promo: ' + cops.map((v) => v.spec.kind + '@' + Math.round(Math.hypot(v.x - c.x, v.z - c.z))).join(',') + ' / ' + cops.length + ' cruisers rigged, heli ' + !!H);

shots.move: The Great Calamitini fires: slow-motion follow of the flight
shots.setup: g.game.sky.ask(12.5, 'clear', true); g.teleport(94, 420, 0); const L = g.game.launchers; L.testMount('strand'); L.testAim(0.8, 0.7); P.pl = g.game.player;
shots.preroll: const L = g.game.launchers; L.testFire(); let n = 0; while (L.state !== 'flight' && n < 600) { g.step(1); n++; } g.step(4); P.pl = g.game.player.person; console.log('cannon ' + L.state + ' after ' + n + ' steps');

shots.setup: g.stage(4); g.game.sky.ask(13, 'clear', true); g.teleport(-607, -1152, 0); P.store = { x: 0, y: 4.9, z: 0 };

shots.move: long lens down a snowy avenue: a bull moose standing in the lane
shots.setup: g.game.sky.ask(15.5, 'clear', true); const M = g.game.moose; let si = M.sites.findIndex((s) => /Anchor/.test(s.name) && Math.abs(s.z + 170) < 30); if (si < 0) si = M.sites.findIndex((s) => /Anchor/.test(s.name)); const s = M.sites[si]; M.forced = { si, t0: g.game.sky.hour * 60 - 36, bull: true, calf: false, stand: 120, side: 1 }; g.teleport(s.x, s.z, 0); g.step(1); P.site = { x: s.x, y: g.info().y, z: s.z }; g.teleport(s.x, s.z - 40, 0); console.log('promo: moose site ' + s.name + ' ' + Math.round(s.x) + ',' + Math.round(s.z) + ' dir ' + s.dx.toFixed(2) + ',' + s.dz.toFixed(2));

shots.preroll: let n = 0; P.each = (dt) => { n += dt; if (n > 2 && !P.go) { P.go = 1; for (const id of P.cars) { const v = g.game.vehicles.list.find((c) => c.id === id); if (v) v.driver = 'ai'; } } };

shots.move: crane down into Main St's Christmas lights at night
from the pier head: the fireworks finale, extra shells on the beat
shots.preroll: const F = g.game.fireworks; const done = new Set(); const n = P.beats.length; P.each = () => { P.beats.forEach((b, k) => { if (k === 0) return; const vol = k >= n - 3 ? 5 : 1; for (let j = 0; j < vol; j++) { const key = k * 10 + j; if (done.has(key)) continue; const h = vol > 1 ? 70 + j * 9 : 40 + (k % 4) * 12; const rise = Math.sqrt(2 * h / 16) * 0.96; if (P.t >= b - rise) { done.add(key); if (b - rise > -0.05) F.launch(['peony', 'willow', 'peony', 'ring'][(k + j) % 4], (vol > 1 ? (j - 2) * 55 : ((k * 37) % 5 - 2) * 40), -0.8, 800 + (j % 2) * 30, h, (k + j) % 6, (k + 2 * j + 3) % 6); } } }); };
